text: I understand this is frustrating. Since I'm unable to locate your account or order #W0001234 with the information provided, and this seems to be beyond what I can resolve with the tools available to me, I'll need to transfer you to a human agent who can investigate this further and help you locate your order.
zh: 我理解这很令人沮丧。由于我无法根据您提供的信息找到您的账户或订单 #W0001234，而且这似乎超出了我可用工具的解决范围，我需要将您转接给一位人类客服，他们可以进一步调查并帮助您找到您的订单。
